items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps the routine comfortable for oily-looking skin while you start an exfoliating product.
One glycolic toner at night suits the uneven texture in your scan without stacking several strong actives.
A lightweight barrier moisturizer helps balance moisture and offsets dryness from exfoliating.
Glycolic acid can make skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside it.

response.routine_note: Start the toner 2 nights a week at night, then build up slowly as your skin tolerates it, and wear SPF every morning. I left out the retinol and benzoyl peroxide wash because using all three together tends to irritate and won't speed up results, and your acne and wrinkle scores already look healthy; if you want retinol later, add it on different nights from the toner.
